notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Hollow Sentinel, adding {U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
